mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which can be exacerbated by fluticasone's mineralocorticoid effects and potassium-wasting properties.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustment of fluticasone or alternative antifungal; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation.
